name: Beijing Jingwei Hirain Technologies Co., Inc.
summary: Beijing Jingwei Hirain Technologies Co., Inc. is a Chinese enterprise dedicated to the development, manufacturing, and commercialization of sophisticated electronic systems for the automotive sector. The company offers a broad array of products, including pioneering solutions for intelligent driving and advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS). These encompass intelligent driving domain controllers, vehicle-mounted computing platforms, millimeter-wave radar units, vehicle cameras, high-precision positioning modules, and driver monitoring systems. Additionally, the firm provides smart connectivity electronics, such as remote communication controllers (T-Box) and gate controllers. For vehicle body and comfort functionalities, Beijing Jingwei Hirain supplies various electronic components, including anti-pinch controllers, full-featured body control systems for passenger vehicles, keyless entry and start systems, dedicated body domain controllers, door and body control systems for commercial vehicles, electric tailgate controllers, door domain controllers, and seat controllers. Its portfolio also extends to chassis control systems, featuring electric power steering controllers, electronic parking systems, brake-by-wire technology, and chassis domain controllers. Furthermore, the company delivers electronic solutions for new energy and powertrain systems, suchising vehicle control units, battery management systems, and power transfer modules. Beyond its extensive product range, Beijing Jingwei Hirain offers customized development services for specific automotive electronic needs. The company, which was founded in Beijing, China, in 2003, continues to operate from its base in the city.
